TINHEADS_COMBAT_HUD.Title: Tinhead's Combat Hud

TokenHUD.Hint: Open Tinhead's Combat Hud for this token

Sections.ActionHint: Attack, Cast Spell, Dodge, Dash, Disengage, Help, Ready, or Other.
Sections.BonusHint: Bonus actions and spells you cast as a bonus action.
Sections.ReactionHint: Attack of Opportunity, plus reactions from your sheet.
Sections.CastSpellHint: Choose a spell level, then a spell to cast.

BasicActions.Hint: Core combat action — announces in chat if no matching sheet item.
BasicActions.FromSheet: Uses the matching item or activity from the character sheet.

CunningAction.Hint: Hover for Hide, Dash, and Disengage.

Features.ClassFeatureHint: Class feature from your character sheet.
Features.OpenModesHint: Hover for options (e.g. Channel Divinity modes).

Checks.AbilityHint: Roll using the dnd5e ability helpers.

Opportunity.Label: Attack of Opportunity
Opportunity.Hint: Make a melee attack as a reaction when a creature leaves your reach.

ReadyNest.Hint: Choose the action you are readying.
ReadyNest.AttackHint: Ready a weapon attack or an unarmed strike.
ReadyNest.OtherHint: Ready some other action. It resolves when the trigger happens.

OtherActions.Label: Other
OtherActions.Hint: Shove, grapple, mount, and similar actions.

Abilities.Label: Abilities
Abilities.Hint: Class features from your character sheet.

WeaponNest.AbilityHint: Uses this activity from the weapon on your character sheet.
WeaponNest.AttackHint: Make a weapon attack with this item.
WeaponNest.UseAbilityHint: Special weapon modes and properties (e.g. Cube of Force).

Notify.ChooseTargetHint: Click a token. Press Esc to cancel.
Notify.NoActor: No usable actor for this token.

EndTurn.Label: End Turn
EndTurn.Hint: End this token's turn. Only the active combatant can advance the tracker.

Drag.Hint: Drag this ring to reposition the combat hud.
Drag.HubHint: Drag to move; click to end turn.

Proxy.SocketlibMissing: Enable the socketlib module for proxy resolve (absent-player control). Owners and GMs can still resolve locally.
Proxy.Unauthorized: You are not allowed to proxy that action.
Proxy.RequestFailed: Proxy request failed — is a GM connected?

TINHEADS_COMBAT_HUD.DismissHint: Esc or click outside to close
